subject: Next steps & evidence delivery for Quantiva pilot (SOC2 / pen test / retention)

Subject: Quantiva pilot - follow up on controls & artifacts

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the demo earlier — good conversation. Quantiva's security and procurement team asked me to capture the artifacts they'll need to complete a pilot security review so we can move to procurement. High level asks from our side: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) or attestation summary
- Pen test executive summary (redacted OK) + vendor name and date
- Sample audit/log retention details (where logs live, S3 vs local, retention default)
- Data retention & deletion policy (customer data handling, backups)
- Any certifications / compliance attachments (ISO, HIPAA addenda if applicable)

Can you send a one-page evidence list + timeline for delivery? Our target is to complete the security review by July 26 so procurement can issue an LOI the following week. Also note Quantiva's decision criteria: data isolation options, SLA for token latency, and the ability to pin model versions.

Elena
Elena Kostov
Director, Infrastructure Security
Quantiva Analytics

Summary (what we'll provide)
- SOC 2: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (executive summary + scope). Full report available under NDA; if you need the full report we can coordinate secure sharing.
- Pen test: pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf (exec summary + vendor/date). Full report available after a mutual NDA.
- Audit/Logs: short note on retention and access controls (included in attached evidence_delivery_template.xlsx, sheet: logs).
- Data retention & deletion: DPA template + retention SLAs (dpa_redwood_v1.2.pdf attached).

Proposed timeline
- Jul 13: send SOC2 exec summary + redacted pen-test summary (today/tomorrow) — DONE/ATTACHED
- Jul 14–17: Rishi to confirm sampling windows for audit logs and provide sample extracts (anonymized)
- Jul 18: Deliver DPA and retention appendix for procurement review
- Jul 20: Complete any outstanding clarifying artifacts; confirm procurement checklist ready for LOI

Open items (for Quantiva to confirm)
- Which procurement contact will sign the DPA / MSA? (You mentioned CJordan; can you confirm full name and email?)
- Any specific retention windows you need for logs or backups beyond our standard 90/365/730 buckets?

Attachments: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf, evidence_delivery_template.xlsx, dpa_redwood_v1.2.pdf

Next steps for internal team (please action):
- Rishi: ownership on pen test/forensics artifacts + sample logs (deliver by 7/17)
- Marissa: commercial timing + confirm procurement contact and whether DocuSign is acceptable
- Logan: if Quantiva asks for dedicated capacity (VPC / dedicated pool), please prepare a rough capacity/price note

Thanks — will forward the redacted pen test and SOC2 summary to Quantiva security shortly.

Best,

Looping in details from SecOps. Short answers and ownership: 

- SOC2: we will provide the exec summary today (attached by Maya). Full SOC2 Type II report requires an internal release approval; we can share it under an NDA. Owner: Rishi (security).
- Pen test: vendor is RedShield Labs, test date 2028-04-02. We can produce a 2-page redacted exec summary (attached). Full report will require legal review and a redaction pass (estimate 3 business days after NDA). Owner: Rishi/RedShield liaison.
- Audit logs & retention: logs are in our central S3 bucket (s3://redwood-logs/), retention tiers default to 90d (hot), 365d (warm), 730d (cold). We can produce a sample event stream (anonymized) showing auth events and inference audit entries. Delivery ETA: 7/17.
- Data retention & deletion: customer-controlled retention via console + API; standard backups retained 90/365/730. DPA template attached; legal to confirm clause 4.2 (deletion on termination) — may need small edits.

Risk note: Quantiva asked about dedicated isolation. If they require tenant-dedicated GPUs or air-gapped options, that will trigger a pricing/ops exception; Logan please prepare a fast quote.

Jira / tracking: SUP-421 (evidence request) created to track artifacts and owner assignments.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
